title: The Complete Pokédex Dataset (Gen I–IX)
subtitle: All 1,025 Pokémon + 1,578 forms: stats, moves, evolutions, SQL & artwork
description:
# The Complete Pokédex Dataset

Every **released Pokémon — all 1,025 species** from Generation I (Red/Green) to Generation IX (Scarlet/Violet and its DLC), #0001 Bulbasaur to #1025 Pecharunt, plus every **form**, **evolution method**, **move** and **learnset**, with **2,410 artworks** that link to the data, and everything also packaged as one **SQLite database**.

## What's inside

| File | Rows | One row per |
|---|---|---|
| `pokemon_utf8.csv` | 1,025 | species: types, stats, abilities, type matchups, breeding, EV yield, evolution chain, Megas, description (70 columns) |
| `pokemon_forms.csv` | 1,578 | form: 97 Megas, 34 Gigantamax, 58 regional forms, alternate formes and cosmetic variants, each with its own types, stats and abilities |
| `evolutions.csv` | 702 | evolution method, branching and form-specific evolutions included, with a readable condition for each |
| `moves.csv` | 920 | move: type, category, power, accuracy, PP, priority, effects |
| `pokemon_moves.csv` | 665,810 | learnset entry: who learns what, how and at what level, in every game from Red/Green to Legends: Z-A |
| `images.csv` | 2,410 | artwork: the species and exact form it shows, its types, size and a fixed train/val/test split |
| `pokemon_stats.csv` | 6,150 | (species, base stat), long format for plotting |
| `pokedex.sqlite` | — | all of the above with primary and foreign keys |

Artwork: `small_images/` (1,025 × 215 px official artwork), `large_images/` (1,025 high-resolution, up to 1280 px) and `alt_images/` (360 alternate forms: Megas incl. Legends: Z-A, Gigantamax, regional forms and more).

`pokemon.csv` holds the same species data as `pokemon_utf8.csv` in the original UTF-16, tab-separated format, kept for older notebooks.

## Quick start

```python
import pandas as pd
pokemon = pd.read_csv('/kaggle/input/pokedex/pokemon_utf8.csv')
forms = pd.read_csv('/kaggle/input/pokedex/pokemon_forms.csv')
megas = forms[forms.is_mega == 1]
```

```python
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('/kaggle/input/pokedex/pokedex.sqlite')
pd.read_sql('''
    SELECT p.english_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.move_id) AS moves_learnable
    FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_moves pm ON pm.national_number = p.national_number
    JOIN version_groups vg ON vg.version_group_id = pm.version_group_id
    WHERE vg.version_group = 'scarlet-violet'
    GROUP BY p.english_name ORDER BY moves_learnable DESC LIMIT 10''', con)
```

## Ideas

- **Classification:** predict legendary status, type or generation from stats; predict type from artwork with `images.csv` (the split is assigned by species, so forms of one Pokémon never leak across splits)
- **Clustering and visualization:** stat archetypes, how stats change across generations, type coverage
- **Graphs:** evolution trees from `evolutions.csv`
- **SQL practice:** joins across species, forms, moves and learnsets
- **Team building:** type coverage plus learnsets plus stats
- **NLP:** Pokédex descriptions and move texts

## Quality

- Every row is checked by `scripts/validate.py`. It checks keys, stat ranges, base stat totals, EV yields, gender ratios and Kaggle-safe file names. It recomputes every `against_*` value from the type chart and confirms each table agrees with the others.
- The 1,025 species were cross-checked field by field against the PokéAPI database. Where values differed, current Scarlet/Violet game data was used. For example, Cresselia's and Zacian's Gen IX stat changes are applied, and the Hisuian Pokémon keep their Scarlet/Violet capture rates rather than the Legends: Arceus ones.

## Sources and credits

- **Species data:** Serebii.net
- **Pokédex descriptions:** pokemon.com
- **Artwork:** Bulbapedia
- **Forms, evolutions, moves, learnsets and the added species fields:** derived from the [PokéAPI](https://github.com/PokeAPI/pokeapi) CSV database. Copyright © 2013–2023 Paul Hallett and PokéAPI contributors, BSD-3-Clause.
- **Trademarks:** Pokémon and Pokémon character names are trademarks of Nintendo. The artwork is © Nintendo, Creatures Inc. and GAME FREAK and is included for non-commercial research and education.

The pipeline is reproducible: `pokedex.ipynb` is the scraper and `scripts/build_tables.py` builds the relational tables. Both are on [GitHub](https://github.com/cristobalmitchell/pokedex).

fields.description: How it is learned: Level up, Machine (TM/TR/HM), Egg, Tutor, Train, Move reminder, ...

fields.name: level
fields.description: Level it is learned at (Level up only; 0 or 1 = on evolution / at start).

fields.name: version_group
fields.description: Game(s) the learnset applies to (e.g. scarlet-violet, legends-za).

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Generation of that game (I–IX).

resources.description: Image manifest for the 2,410 bundled artworks: species, the exact form shown, its types, pixel size and a fixed species-level train/val/test split for image models.

fields.name: image_file
fields.description: Path relative to the image folders, e.g. "small_images/001.png". Primary key.

fields.name: image_set
fields.description: small_images (215×215), large_images (300–1280 px) or alt_images (alternate forms).

fields.name: file_name
fields.description: File name.

fields.name: national_number
fields.description: National Pokédex number (1–1025) of the species. Joins to pokemon_utf8.csv.

fields.name: english_name
fields.description: English species name.

fields.name: form_label
fields.description: Form label parsed from an alt_images file name (e.g. "Mega X"); blank for the primary artwork.

fields.name: form_id
fields.description: The form the artwork shows; joins to pokemon_forms.csv. Blank for 4 non-battle variants (Rotom Phone, Rotom Pokédex, Zygarde Cell and Core).

fields.name: pokemon_id
fields.description: Variety id of that form.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Display name of that form.

fields.name: primary_type
fields.description: Primary type of the form shown (the label for type-classification models).

fields.name: secondary_type
fields.description: Secondary type of the form shown.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Image width in pixels.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Image height in pixels.

fields.name: split
fields.description: Fixed train / val / test split (70/15/15), assigned by species and stratified by primary type, so every image of a species is in the same split.

resources.description: All tables in one SQLite database with primary and foreign keys: pokemon, pokemon_forms, pokemon_stats, evolutions, moves, pokemon_moves (integer keys, with move_methods and version_groups lookup tables) and images. Query it with sqlite3 or pandas.read_sql.
